Register for a workshop. Before this, the rate limit is checked and the composition root builds the use case. The lock is taken before any seat count is read. The cache is invalidated after the commit.
Locks the workshop, confirms a seat
or joins the waitlist. Repeating it
free seats, the status of a new
success, rolls back on error, runs
Versioned cache keys for the public
